gate_reasoning: 87% of claims score Low confidence. The two most-cited cost anchors — MMB HBS 2024 inpatient/outpatient figures (Rp 22M / Rp 3.6M) and the OJK loss ratio data (105.7% / 71.2%) — are both Low due to paywalled primaries and press-release-only access. The group health GWP market size (USD 776M) rests entirely on a Mordor Intelligence aggregator with no OJK cross-validation. All four of these figures are cited 6–10 times each and underpin the entire PP6.1 cost narrative, PP6.4 self-funded exposure calculations, and the Stage 6 market size table. A targeted deep research pass (3 specific fetches: MMB HBS 2024 primary, OJK Insurance Statistics 2024, OJK group health GWP) could potentially upgrade 8–12 claims from Low to Medium or High, resolving the most structurally critical gaps before this stage is gated for final cross-stage compilation.
